title: Real World Table Tennis
description: A multimodal dataset of high-density, dual-layer EEG, neck EMG, inertial measurement unit acceleration, T1 structural MRI, and video recorded from 25 participants playing real-world table tennis. Each participant played 60 minutes of table tennis against a ball machine and a human player, plus a 10-minute standing baseline. Processed data include ICA decompositions and dipole models, with raw data in the sourcedata folder.
methods_description: Dual-layer high-density EEG, neck EMG, and IMU acceleration were recorded during 60 minutes of table tennis with a ball machine and a human player, plus a 10-minute standing baseline. Video was recorded for 17 participants, with hit events marked in Adobe Premiere project files. Processed data include ICA decomposition and dipole models stored in EEG.etc, with retained components in EEG.etc.KeepComponents.
